mapper.insert: insert into sys_oper_log(title, business_type, method, request_method, operator_type, oper_name, dept_name, oper_url, oper_ip, oper_location, oper_param, json_result, change_diff, status, error_msg, cost_time, oper_time, user_agent) values (#{title}, #{businessType}, #{method}, #{requestMethod}, #{operatorType}, #{operName}, #{deptName}, #{operUrl}, #{operIp}, #{operLocation}, #{operParam}, #{jsonResult}, #{changeDiff}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{costTime}, sysdate(), #{userAgent})
mapper.delete: delete from sys_oper_log where oper_id in #{operId}
delete from sys_oper_log where oper_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{days} day)
